description: Land Title Settlement Department - Kosgoda, Kuruwita D/S Division, Rathnapura District - Cad. Map No. 620275
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registrations and determinations under the Registration of Title Act. It contains detailed schedules with specific land parcel numbers, ownership details, property extents, and encumbrances for multiple land parcels in various villages. The content falls under "Land registrations, property ownership, land titles" as defined in Type 4 (Land Gazettes), and appears in "PART III - LANDS" of the gazette publication.
